comment: The article exhibits a clear left-leaning bias by framing the Democrats' opposition to voter ID as 'voter suppression,' suggesting that their stance is illogical or extreme when compared with other common identification requirements for various activities (buying alcohol and cigarettes, renting cars). The article also implies a negative portrayal of Democratic representatives by highlighting the hypocrisy in requiring IDs to shovel snow but opposing voter ID laws. There is no explicit mention or discussion about right-leaning voices; hence guests_bias cannot be determined from this excerpt.
